method:
Joint weak spectral-map/material test on accepted switch revision5.
Fixed sources, masks, shape, shadows, ordinary/directional kernels and source-brightness response.
Compare a material-only control with one shared nonnegative spectral deviation scale:
F_c(x)=x+(1+sign_c*s)*(F_green(x)-x), sign_R=-1, sign_B=+1.
Not physical ray tracing or an identified Apple surface. Unlike prior fixed-material
screens, this tests whether lighting compensation masks a useful spectral direction.
Original native gates plus2percent crops relative to frozen revision4 constrain
proposals. Each full experiment is one family, never one pass per iteration.
